explanation: Threat Path Analysis: Adversary initiated credential stuffing on bastion 192.168.56.20, achieved initial foothold on host lab-win10-03 (192.168.56.31), and established an internal SMB named-pipe session to domain controller lab-dc-01 (192.168.56.10). An obfuscated base64 PowerShell child process was spawned 40s later to dump credentials.
containment_recommendation: Propose isolation of compromised workstation lab-win10-03 (192.168.56.31) with dry_run=True, reversible=True, ttl_seconds=3600. Do NOT isolate lab-dc-01 to avoid catastrophic domain outage. Request HITL authorization before applying.
remediation_draft: 1. Reset compromised 'admin' domain credentials. 2. Enforce SMB signing across 192.168.56.0/24. 3. Deploy Sigma detection rule for brute-force followed by internal SMB within 5 minutes.

proposal.reason: Compromised workstation actively pivoting to domain controller
